period_note: Cumulative-from-Jan-1 convention established from the filing's own column header '01 January to 30 September 2017' (the filing also separately shows a discrete 3-month column, not used here). Standalone/Solo basis. Source PDF (3rd_quarter_2017.pdf) is a native digital PDF; pdftotext -layout extraction had minor cosmetic spacing artifacts (missing thousands-separators in a few provision sub-lines, e.g. '1081811 434') but all figures were verifiable by component summation and are used as-is: balance sheet ties to the taka (Total Liabilities 176,203,711,301 + Total Shareholders' Equity 16,234,994,823 = Total Assets 192,438,706,124); Profit before tax 2,411,678,799 - Provision for tax 1,308,850,192 = Profit after tax 1,102,828,607, matching the filing's own EPS of 1.25. Cross-check: comparative '31 December 2016' column (Total Assets BDT 172,706.23mn, Total Shareholders' Equity BDT 16,542.20mn) matches the existing bank_financials/NCCBANK/quarterly/2016_Q4.json exactly; the comparative 'Jan-Sep 2016' cumulative P&L column also matches the 2016_Q3.json record exactly at every subtotal from Profit before provisions onward (Profit after tax BDT 941.26mn in both), despite an immaterial ~BDT 3mn gross-up difference between Total operating income and Total operating expense that nets to zero.
